notes.title: Minor Patch 1.41 - Treasure Marker and SFX
notes.notes:
I have released a minor patch for the demo which aims to make the treasure chest experience more fair to the player!


Treasure Markers
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255696/54632a7941e30ed2f8d550cb5887a36f8fed2025.png"]When you are within a set radius from a treasure chest, a marker will be displayed to let you know where it is, additionally a sound effect will play in order to alert you. I hope this addition makes finding treasure easier in your runs. Treasure chests contain powerful upgrades that can juice up any build.



Additionally a sound effect has been added to boss fish in order to give them a more "menacing" presence

notes.title: Major Demo Patch 1.4 - Treasure, balance and a visual overhaul!
notes.notes:
Demo patch 1.4 is out now and is full of various updates! At the beginning of Fishing Mega-Game's development I had planned to release the treasure feature, but felt it wasn't ready. Well, now it is!


ChangelogMajor Changes
Some more information on these will be posted below!

Treasure chests have been added to each level, seek them out!

Each level has had it's visuals improved to feel more vibrant and aquatic.

Balances have been made to the combat system to make some upgrades more viable. (Nothing was nerfed!)
Minor Changes
Bugs and QoL

Fixed an issue where under certain circumstances, fish could spawn outside of the level.

Level-Up choices can now be skipped so players aren't forced to choose an unwanted attack.

Tutorial text has been changed to address updates.

Experience shells have been adjusted to increase performance.


Detailed ChangesTreasure Chests have been added!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255696/922b463e268ec29d217963d9f020a428fe3e4eae.png"]Keep an eye out in every level for treasure chests which are mostly randomly populated! These can be picked up the same way that shells are, but instead of experience points, they offer one of three exclusive powerful upgrades. These upgrades can either be large stat upgrades, or unique alterations to your current attacks.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255696/080c79231a879625c478dcd21cb45b3ae8200b60.png"]These upgrades correspond to what attacks you currently have equipped, so choose carefully. These can turn the tide of a level quickly!


Visual Enhancements
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255696/9133ea6c5ebae41e8a9739fa7da9a3515266004a.gif"]

I have created a shader that makes levels look more aquatic! Furthermore I can apply colors to it to give the world a more colorful look. We have also edited our level tilesets to have different color themes. The demo features a mossy green! The new trailer showcases some of the new level looks that use these colors, please take a look!


Balances
I am striving to make Fishing Mega-Game a balanced bullet heaven full of over powerful builds and fun challenges. To do so I have changed every enemy's health and speed values as well as how they scale throughout the level. In accordance with this, I have also increased the damage of many player attacks as well as how they scale. Please try them out!


What's next?
In regard to the demo, I am not planning any more major updates! I will however be making minor changes as I see fit. Fishing Mega-Game will be featured as part of October's Steam Next Fest, so if you see any bugs or inconsistencies in the demo, please reach out on discord! 

For the full release, the remaining overworld maps are about 80% done at the moment! I also have a few new levels developed, some of which can be seen in the trailer.

notes.title: Major Demo Patch 1.3 - Balance and Tutorial Changes
notes.notes:
With demo patch 1.3 I have aimed to heavily improve the onboarding process. Feedback from playtesters and content creators have made it clear that this was lacking. This update should give an new and returning player a better explanation of how the game works, as well as what is in the demo and what may come after!


ChangelogMajor Changes
These changes will be explained with further detail down below!

Default difficulty adjustment.

The fish menu now contains all fish to be added at release.

UI has been added to indicate if an area can be enchanted.

When applicable, music correctly loops now.

SFX and music volume settings will now be saved.

UI has been added to show active attack abilities while fishing.

New player experience has been improved.


Minor Changes
Bugs and smaller adjustments

Text has been modified for clarity.

Shell color has been adjusted for visibility, new tiers of shells have been added.

Corrected an error where having a shiny fish would block you from selecting it's basic form unless you toggled it on first.

Enchantment rates have been adjusted.


Detailed ChangesDefault difficulty adjusted
All three available levels have had their spawn rates changed, and the crayfish have been slowed down a degree. Previously there was a big issue, especially in the second level where crayfish would appear too early, putting a huge strain on the player as they searched for a catch. Crayfish still spawn after some time, and they are still very fast, but now they will spawn later, giving the player time to build up their defenses.


All fish have been added
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255696/a6b8ebe57c845d1285a20e100cb86bb6ce83dba8.gif"]

While the demo only contains 4 catchable fish, the full list of 65 is visible. Certain details are kept hidden, their shadow and base area are revealed for now. Please look forward to their full appearances later on!


Enchanted UI
Enchantments exist to alter the difficulty and increase shiny probability for fish. Enchantments are only available on a level if every fish in that level has been caught. UI has been added to show whether that is the case or not.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255696/ae12a1599c2b7439ffc37f0973cb98b49e4ad0bd.png"]

Enchantments are available.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255696/9e0f3bb670b5c649b339f555ca3406445121e699.png"]

Enchantments are active.


Music looping
Most music in Fishing Mega-Game was meant to loop. The composer has made adjustments to the existing songs so that we can loop them properly. This creates a better auditory experience while fishing.


Sound settings can be saved!
Previously when adjusting the music and SFX volume levels, they would revert to 100% after restarting. Now they will save and reapply automatically to save player's the hassle or re-doing it.


Active attack UI
While fishing, you may select 3 attacks in addition to the base attack. This was not very clear originally, so UI has been added to display all active attacks.


New player experience and tutorial windows
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45255696/c45ad119cf820ff6734862240a40e243259fa424.gif"]

While the core gameplay loop of Fishing Mega-Game is similar to popular survivors-like games, there are unique differences that were not made clear. To combat this, tutorial windows are now available. When beginning Fishing Mega-Game for the first time, tutorial windows will automatically display to nudge the player into catching their first fish. Once they have, these tutorials can still be read from the pause menu. Additionally, tutorial windows have been added to the fish, shop, and enchantment menus under the "?" button. These should answer all questions related to the mechanics.


What's next?
I have one more planned demo patch. Currently the demo is lacking "treasure" that will appear while fishing. These treasure chests will contain more powerful upgrades for the player.

I will also implement minor changes such as:

Skipping level up upgrades when you do not like the selection.

Damage scaling to make some upgrades grow in potential faster than their stronger counterparts.

After that, I will continue solely on the remaining zones, levels and fish! I will still be updating the demo based on feedback, so as always, feel free to join the discord!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.2
notes.notes:
Demo Patch 1.2 is released!
Here is a list of what has changed:

Minor text corrections

Attack damage adjustments

Corrected an error where cage amount upgrades didn't register

Experience shells updated to be pink for better visibility

Corrected a drop rate bug

Fixed an issue where multiple menus could open at the same time

Properly implemented music loops

Adjusted certain sound effects

Changed sand dollar calculation to no longer be health dependent

Added idle animations for the player and NPCs


Future Updates
While I continue work on the rest of the game I will be releasing another larger balance patch soon. This will adjust the difficulty, especially for "First Pond" which can be very hard at first! I will also implement better tutorials so that players can be onboarded much more seamlessly.


Thanks!
These updates come from videos and streams as well as player-given feedback. Feel free to join the conversation, here!
